review_description: Liam was the only installer who said he needed to see my system first before he could give me a quote on a battery installation. When he came he explained exactly what I should get and why, and in a way I could understand. He wasn’t affiliated with any brand of battery so he could recommend the best battery for my system. He also found some  dodgy workmanship from the company that installed my solar system and rectified it. After the installation, he kept in touch and answered all my questions very politely.

Ash and Liam were great through the process of going solar.The quote process was easy, and they were happy to listen to all my questions and modify the proposal to eet the needs I had. They were even able to assist with the installation of the a Heat pump hot water system.The only hitch was a delay in the installation process based on the huge uptick in demand following the battery rebbates from the federal government. The process of managing the apploication for allthe governement support was great and the pricing was very clear. there were no late changes or additions.The customer service during the process was excellent. Questions were answered honestly, if anything they under promised and over delivered in all the areas they they had control over
